newsitem.title: UK: BFI up one as weeks starts steady but quiet.
newsitem.headline: BFI up one as weeks starts steady but quiet.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was up one point on Monday at 1,372 points.

Brokers said despite firmer fixtures of modern Panamaxes in the east for three to five months at $10,600 daily and Cargill's very firm fixture of Sea Eagle for 55,000 wheat Houston to Egyptian Med for July 20/25 at $16.50 brokers said that conditions were generally quiet but steady in most areas.

However, Caper brokers were less optimistic about short term prospects and the anticipated revival in demand from grain housaes for Handy-sizes in the US Gulf and East Coast South America was stilll awaited.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was unchanged to five points lower and turnover totalled only five lots.
